capabilities: Create a screenplay project folder with five pre-structured files
Add character entries with archetype, want, need, flaw, and arc
Add scene cards with number, location, time, characters, action, and purpose
Browse all projects in a sidebar with format, status, and scene count
disambiguation: Not a formatted-screenplay editor or exporter; it scaffolds and organizes development documents, not final script pages.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure or workflow for developing screenplays, so writers must set up and organize treatment, outline, character, and beat files themselves.
summary: Screenplay development toolkit that scaffolds Markdown projects with treatments, outlines, character arcs, scene cards, and Blake Snyder beat sheets.
